좋아요 누르면 시방오토바이. (시바견 오토바이) 특징: 방귀 부스터 (속도:8/10 지구력:6/10)

친구 초대하면 코닉세그. 특징: 비행기 엔진으로 하늘 날기 (속도: 7/10 지구력: 3/10)

나머지 차: F1 cars. (모두 속도와 지구력: 1/10과 1/10


게임이름: battle of the racing cars (레이싱카들의 대결)

레이싱 코스: 5가지 1:탕후루 asmr course 2:두쫀쿠 asmr course 3:팝잇 asmr course 4:왁뿌볼 asmr course 5:키캡 asmr course

answers.ask: Are these lap circuits or point-to-point sprints? Nothing in the prompt says whether a race is timed laps or a single run.
answers.answer: 각 ASMR 코스는 한 바퀴를 도는 랩 서킷으로 만들고, 레이스는 1랩 완주 방식으로 해주세요.

answers.ask: How long should one lap be, given the cars range from very fast to very slow?
answers.answer: 한 랩은 작은 맵에서 약 1~2분 안에 완주할 수 있는 짧은 길이로 해주세요.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D racing game map collection for Battle of the Racing Cars, with five separate compact one-lap circuit courses designed to be completed in roughly 1–2 minutes each. Build a tanghulu ASMR course, a chewy chocolate-cookie ASMR course, a pop-it ASMR course, a wax-bubble-ball ASMR course, and a keycap ASMR course; each track forms a closed loop through oversized props and themed surfaces associated with its ASMR material.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Racing: players compete in vehicles over designated closed routes. There is no secondary genre.

### Shape and preset
Use `route-circuit`, following the Circuit Racing preset. The collection contains five distinct compact closed-loop circuits, each raced for one lap; the separate themed courses override the preset’s assumption of a single map.

### Config requirements
Use `lane-corridor` for clearly readable themed road surfaces and track edges around every loop. Use `barrier-guardrail` as physical containment along turns and hazardous outer edges, dressed to each ASMR theme. Use `spawn-grid` for a shared vehicle launch line at each circuit’s start/finish straight. Use `startpoint-line` and `trigger-finish` as visible start/finish markings on that same straight.

### Layout requirements
Place `spawn-grid` with one aligned starting row at the start/finish straight of each of the five circuits. Place `startpoint-line` and `trigger-finish` across that row, with the finish trigger counting a single completed lap. Place `trigger-lap` once per circuit at the start/finish crossing to validate the closed loop. Place `checkpoint-respawn` at least one recovery point around the far side of each compact circuit, restoring a vehicle facing forward on the track.

### Layout components
Build five separate compact maps: a tanghulu ASMR circuit with oversized glossy fruit skewers and syrup-like bends; a chewy chocolate-cookie circuit with thick cookie slabs and soft chocolate-textured curves; a pop-it circuit threaded around giant bubble-grid props; a wax-bubble-ball circuit with rounded waxy spheres and smooth molded banks; and a keycap circuit running between oversized keyboard keys. Each map has one unbroken, legible loop, a broad start/finish straight, continuous drivable surface, themed guardrails, and no ambiguous crossings. Frame each circuit from an elevated isometric angle so its full loop and dominant oversized props read clearly.

### Render order
Use `authored_plan`: every circuit must be a valid, continuous one-lap route before it is dressed, because a broken or ambiguous loop makes racing unplayable.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large overall because the collection contains five maps, though each individual circuit is compact and intended for a roughly 1–2 minute lap. Theme: playful surreal ASMR toy-and-snack racing worlds with oversized tactile props. Use `P4` because these are five separate maps, and `P6` because every circuit route must be valid by construction.
